business_problem: Hamburg Port Authority needed to make everyday service workflows genuinely useful to employees before it could scale platform adoption and add AI into port operations.
solution_summary: Hamburg Port Authority needed to make everyday service workflows genuinely useful to employees before it could scale platform adoption and add AI into port operations. Hamburg Port Authority implemented a ServiceNow-centered stack built around ServiceNow AI Platform, App Engine, Now Assist, and RaptorDB. Key components included ServiceNow AI Platform provides the common workflow and AI layer; App Engine builds custom workflow apps; Now Assist adds generative search, summarization, and drafting; RaptorDB accelerates workflow analytics. The stack also connected SharePoint so the workflows could reuse existing records, documents, and collaboration channels instead of forcing teams back into manual handoffs. Work enters as cases, requests, or automations, is classified or summarized by Now Assist and Predictive Intelligence, and uses context from RaptorDB and SharePoint before ServiceNow AI Platform and App Engine routes or fulfills the work.
